name: add_board_outline
notes: IPC mode builds Edge.Cuts with BoardRectangle
column14: or BoardCircle and does not call SWIG. Offline SWIG remains behind the file-ownership check. Not run on the open board.

name: add_board_text
notes: Alias of the add_text IPC and SWIG handlers. Module: python/commands/board/. IPC: KiCADInterface._ipc_add_text.

name: add_component_annotation
notes: Appends the text to the footprint description through one IPC commit and reads it back.

name: add_net
notes: IPC creation is unsupported. A new name returns UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION and an existing name returns ALREADY_EXISTS. Neither success nor a SWIG edit is used.

name: add_net_class
notes: Not an alias of create_netclass. KiCad 10 IPC cannot create a net class.

name: add_wire
notes: Not an alias of add_schematic_wire. No schematic file is edited.

name: add_zone
notes: Creates a zone only when the net exists and reads the net and pad connection back.

name: assign_net_to_class
notes: IPC can read a net class and cannot assign one.

name: check_clearance
notes: No pairwise IPC clearance query. No pass or fail is invented.

name: clone_component
notes: IPC only. No SWIG route. Clears pad nets unless copyNets is true and re-reads the created footprint. IPC: KiCADInterface._ipc_clone_component.

name: delete_trace
notes: IPC mode deletes tracks or vias with remove_items inside a commit and re-reads them. It does not call the SWIG handler. Not run on the open board.

name: execute_tool
notes: registerRouterTools is commented out in src/server.ts.

name: export_gerber
notes: kicad-cli Gerber and drill export from a copy of the saved PCB. SWIG PLOT_CONTROLLER is no longer used.

name: export_netlist
notes: kicad-cli export of the same-named schematic only. The disposable board has no matching schematic.

name: export_position_file
notes: Writes positions read from the open editor. Does not write the PCB.

name: export_vrml
notes: kicad-cli VRML export from a copy of the saved PCB.

name: get_category_tools
notes: registerRouterTools is commented out in src/server.ts.

name: group_components
notes: Creates an IPC group and reads the member ids back. Undo removed the group and left the members.

name: list_tool_categories
notes: registerRouterTools is commented out in src/server.ts.

name: place_component
notes: Prior session confirmed IPC placement. Phase 2 did not change the IPC implementation. IPC mode no longer falls back to the SWIG LoadBoard path. Offline SWIG placement remains and refuses a locked or editor-owned file.

name: replace_component
notes: IPC cannot change a footprint library definition in place.

name: rotate_component
notes: Absolute angle. The handler reads the footprint back and returns the verified rotation. Live-validated on disposable R_PHASE4.

name: route_trace
notes: A requested net must already exist. Success requires the re-read track net to match. The response id is the bare UUID.

name: save_project
notes: IPC mode calls the editor save. If IPC is down
column12: the command returns IPC_UNAVAILABLE instead of SaveBoard. Offline mode SaveBoard is allowed only when the file is not locked and is not the open editor document. Not run on the open board.

name: search_tools
notes: registerRouterTools is commented out in src/server.ts.

name: set_board_size
notes: Success is the return flag from set_size. Reported size is an Edge.Cuts bounding box. Module: python/commands/board/. IPC: KiCADInterface._ipc_set_board_size.
